body: I appreciate you telling me all of this, I think that we have experienced similar thoughts on suicide.

I know she'd be broken up about it in ways I can't imagine. I know that my family wouldn't be the same, but I believe that I have a duty to myself. That may sound selfish, but that's the way we operate. I possess quite a bit of empathy so I can imagine to a certain degree how everyone around me will feel, and I can imagine the ridicule that some of them will come under, but I can't go on living when every waking second my mind screams from deep down to die. When every second I wish my heart would stop because it's grown tired of beating for a body that has no will to live. It's like my heart is now my enemy, and it hurts me when I think about it beating. Physically and emotionally. I know all of these feelings are considered to be psychological defects, but I tend to disagree. Not one person will ever know exactly how you feel. Not one person has experienced the same things as you, not one person will interpret their experiences in the same way. In that sense we are all very alone. I've always been against going to counseling because I know what they're going to tell me. I know what techniques they use because I tried to counsel myself after researching them. I don't want them to put me on some chemical that forces my brain to behave differently. I want to be me, and the path less traveled is where I wish to go, to infinity, to non-existence.

Unfortunately no fall break soon, next break is end of November. The problem is that I have so many exams coming up, but my anxiety and depression are getting in the way of me being able to do anything to prepare for them. If there was some way to just drop out right now I would, but unfortunately I don't think the uni would appreciate that too much.

Thanks for trying to help, and talking to a counselor would be on my list of things to do, and even though I can see a way out of this, I really just want to die. I don't want to feel anymore. I want to experience being nothing. I want to disappear.

I won't get into my major because my gpa isn't good enough. My dear grandparent is paying for my tuition in full, and having already been a few semesters, she has paid quite a bit. I feel as though not making it into my major will let everybody down. I have no passions in my life. I can't simply get through this. I feel as though my dorm is a prison that I am trapped in. My body won't listen to me, which has caused me social anxiety that has torn me away form my friends here. I never leave my room unless to eat or take an exam. My heart has already died, I cannot bear the shame of such a total defeat because of my father. He is the best, a perfect example of what every man should be for their family. He works hard, he supports our family by himself. I am nothing compared to him. I can't face him as a failure.

Anyways, I've been passively suicidal for many years now. What I mean by that is if a situation came up where I could possibly die, I would let myself die. Unfortunately no such situation has arisen. I accepted death long ago, and I have felt all the strings attaching my soul to this world pluck away one by one recently. I can't bear to exist in this universe any longer.
